mapper.select: select concat_ws(':', 'a', a.uid, ma.field) id, ma.data_type type, concat('[属性]', a.name, '(', ma.name, ')') as label from iot_device a left join iot_model_attr ma on ma.product_id=a.product_id where a.device_group_id=#{deviceGroupId} and ma.data_type != 'json'

select concat_ws(':', 'w', a.uid, ma.field) id, 'string' type, concat('[告警]', a.name, '(', ma.name, ')') as label from iot_device a left join iot_model_attr ma on ma.product_id=a.product_id left join iot_warn_config wc on wc.model_attr_id=ma.id and wc.grade != 'status' where ma.id is not null and a.device_group_id=#{deviceGroupId} and ma.data_type != 'json'
select concat_ws(':', 's', a.uid) id, 'string' type, concat('[状态]', a.name) as label from iot_device a where a.device_group_id=#{deviceGroupId}
